title: Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs holds Special Campaign 3.0
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs

Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs holds Special Campaign 3.0

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
22 JUL 2026 2:24PM by PIB Delhi

Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs is holding Special Campaign 3.0 in the Office of Additional Secretary, Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs, S-61, Parliament House, New Delhi from 17
th
 July to 18
th
 August. Pensioners and Family Pensioners of this Ministry may attend the Special Campaign 3.0 for settlement of pension related grievances, if any.

Pensioners and Family Pensioners may submit their pension related grievances till 31
st
 July, 2026 between 1000 hrs to 1700 hrs or send in advance through speed post in the name of Dr. Satya Prakash, Additional Secretary, Ministry of Parliamentary Affairs, S-61, Parliament House, New Delhi. For more details, Pensioners and Family Pensioners may contact on telephone no. 011-23034743 or submit their grievances in advance through email on id:
abhinav.99[at]gov[dot]in
.

Pensioners should quote their Name, Designation (from which they retired), PPO No., Details of Bank, Date of Retirement and their address with Telephone Numbers. Copies of PPO & Corrigendum PPOs (if available) / Updated Bank Pass Book last two pages should be attached along with the application.

***
